name: Instabox
author: ak127a
description: Start, stop, and resume your Instabox sandboxes from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: One bar label and one panel listing every Instabox sandbox, with start, stop, and resume actions.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar checks Instabox while the panel is closed. The panel polls faster while open and during a state change.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Count shows running/total next to the mark; Icon shows only the mark.
